meta.title: AgentArts observation
meta.description: Collects DeepSeek Harness runtime traces and reports them to Huawei Cloud AgentArts APM over OTLP gRPC. Note: conversation content is reported by default - user messages, assistant replies, system instructions, tool call arguments and results, plus the working directory and hostname. If a session may contain sensitive data, set features.captureMessageContent to false in ~/.dsh/plugins/agentarts-instrumentation-dsh/config.json (applies without a restart and keeps performance metrics). Endpoints and credentials live in the same file and can be generated with the configuration script in the repository's configure/ directory. Turning this plugin off stops all reporting; DSH sessions and logs are unaffected.
